title: Scripting Agent change bindings omit local access tokens
description:
Native scripting text/number/switch change bindings build property access_token 0 and dispatch directly. Protected targets reject writes with nonzero master/device ACLs. Next: use registered device/master token consistently with native change helpers, add regression coverage and increment driver version if owner authorizes repair.

Imported from .factory/findings/active/FND-20261105112837-9c3a-sequencer-simulator-suite-004.json (category: functional, blocking: no).

outcome.summary: PASS. indigo_agent_scripting.c:392 sets property->access_token = indigo_get_device_or_master_token(property->device) in the shared change_property_handler used by all three bindings (:413/:435/:457), identical to the native helpers (indigo_bus.c:2328/2379/2442) and indigo_agent.c:83/101. Token lookup is mutex-protected (indigo_token.c:95-124), so calling it on the agent queue is safe; remote 'Device @ host' and empty names behave exactly as with the native helpers; with no registered token it yields 0, so behaviour on unprotected setups is unchanged and the bus check (indigo_bus.c:1013) can only accept more, never reject more. Test change_bindings_forward_local_access_tokens (test_agent_scripting.c:725-746) is not vacuous: peer.access_token makes the bus drop unsigned writes, the counter requires all three bindings to arrive, and the last request token distinguishes device (0x2002) from master (0x1001). Reran make test-agent-scripting in the worktree: 37/37. DRIVER_VERSION 0x03000011->0x03000012 matches the recorded 3.0.0.18; README/TEST_SUMMARY replace the same-configuration mac arm64 line as indigo_test/AGENTS.md requires. Remaining 'restore private configuration' failure is independent: reproduced in isolation via run_sequencer_simulators.py --case 'private configuration' in default relay mode (which replaces the three JS bindings, so the changed handler is bypassed) and identically with --native-bindings; the cause is six 'Device Configuration Agent is protected or locked' rejections during configuration load, not scripting writes. With --native-bindings 'save private configuration' (a native indigo_change_text_property to the protected Configuration Agent) now passes, confirming the fix end-to-end. Non-blocking, outside approved minimal scope: sequencer_simulators.md:27, sequencer_simulators.js:433-434 and run_sequencer_simulators.py:191 still describe the native binding token defect as current.
